entries.t: 打开“深地之窗”：中国科学家完成最深国际大陆科学钻探，获 2025 年度国家科学技术进步一等奖
entries.c: 零碳产业/物质循环/资源处理/勘探技术
entries.as: 王成善院士团队领衔的'松辽盆地国际大陆科学钻探工程'获2025年度国家科学技术进步一等奖。项目历时近二十年，在黑龙江安达完成松科二井钻探，创下国际大陆科学钻探最深钻孔、最长连续岩芯和超高取芯率三项世界纪录，成功打穿白垩纪地层，获取8000余米岩芯、95%以上取芯率。该成果为研究地球温室气候历史打开前所未有的'深地之窗'。
entries.b:
7 月 8 日消息，据央视新闻报道，经过近二十年的持续攻关，由王成善院士团队领衔、国内四十多家单位千余名科研人员参与的“松辽盆地国际大陆科学钻探工程”项目，以
国际大陆科学钻探最深钻孔、最长连续岩芯和超高取芯率三项世界纪录
，成功“打穿”白垩纪地层，为人类读懂地球历史上最典型的温室气候时期打开了一扇前所未有的“深地之窗”。
IT之家获悉，这项研究获得 2025 年度国家科学技术进步一等奖。
据介绍，在黑龙江安达市松辽盆地腹地，松科二井的钻塔之下封存着亿万年的地球记忆。这里是国际大陆科学钻探计划实施以来，全球最深钻孔的诞生地。
中国科学院院士、地质学家王成善称：“因为在地下岩层，每一米代表了 1 万年的沉积历史，我们经过了将近二十年的奋斗，获得了 8000 多米的岩芯，我们钻探的目标就是要建立完整的陆相白垩纪档案，来研究那个时候到底热到什么程度，它整个的气候又是什么状态。”
大陆科学钻探区别于普通石油钻探，完整连续的岩芯钻取是重中之重。为了实现地层研究厘米级的要求，松科二井不仅要打到预定深度，还需实现 95% 以上高取芯率，最大限度维持地层原貌、保证地质样本完整连贯，
这在世界上都是没有先例的
2006 年起，王成善院士团队在松辽盆地布下“三井四孔”，累计进尺逾万米，构建了从钻探选址、岩芯处理到高精度测量与年代标定的全流程自主技术体系，取出的连续岩芯如同一部“编码”亿年时光的巨型史书。标志着
我国在大陆科学钻探领域跻身世界前列
，项目也被国际大陆科学钻探计划盛赞为“灯塔”工程。
随着项目完成，海量岩芯分别存放在位于河北燕郊的全国岩芯库、中国地质大学（北京）岩芯库和大庆油田研究院岩芯库。新一轮解码工作即将全面展开，激光扫描、光谱分析等技术正将岩石中的“时间密码”转化为可量化的科学数据。

entries.t: 不可燃钠离子电池储能系统瞄准电网级储能
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/钠电池
entries.as: Alsym公司开发无锂电池体系，采用钠离子技术路线，核心优势在于不燃且无热失控风险，可在极端温度环境下安全运行。该技术瞄准电网级储能市场，规避锂资源的供应链风险和价格波动。钠在地壳中储量丰富、成本低廉，电池设计不依赖锂、钴、镍等关键矿产。产品定位为固定式储能应用场景，目标替代锂离子电池在电网调峰、可再生能源配套储能领域的地位。当前钠离子电池能量密度仍低于锂电，但安全性优势和成本潜力使其在大型储能领域具备竞争力。
kp: 部署规模[加州电网储能]: 500 MWh
电池化学[钠离子BESS]: 钠/铁/硬碳，无钴无镍
[安全性]: 不燃不热失控，耐极端温度
entries.b:
Alsym's lithium-free sodium-ion battery operates in extreme temps without thermal runaway risk. Targets markets where lithium-ion cannot go.
July 7, 2026
Renewable energy developer Juniper Energy will deploy 500 megawatt hours (MWh) of Alsym's Na-Series BESS across the state of California.
Alsym energy
Lithium-free chemistry uses earth-abundant materials: sodium, iron, hard carbon—no cobalt, nickel, or manganese required
Non-flammable sodium iron pyrophosphate chemistry eliminates thermal runaway risk at the chemical level for safer deployments
Operates from –40°C to 60°C with passive cooling only, enabling deployment in extreme climates where lithium-ion fails
According to a survey conducted in 2024, nearly
three-quarters of the world's population supports
the idea of phasing out fossil fuel utilization as a way of moving to cleaner energy across the globe. Despite the advancement from both public opinion and public policy, the affordability of electricity amid rising costs is becoming a significant challenge to the concept of mass electrification. According to the Center for American Progress, achieving universal rural electrification would require an
estimated annual investment of nearly $20 billion
. Still, this remains more of a billion-person problem than a billion-dollar problem, says Mukesh Chatter, co-founder and chief executive officer at
Alsym Energy
, a Massachusetts-based startup company that develops and supplies a lithium-free, sodium-ion-based battery energy storage system (BESS).
"Around the world today, more than one billion people don't have electricity, or only have access to it sometimes — condemning them to a cycle of no growth, no education, and a life of poverty," said Chatter. "We project that our solution could help 7 billion people, because as massive deployments happen as a function of time, the planet will be helped from a clean energy perspective. The risk of fire in communities, and homes and residential, commercial, industrial will also be less or be avoided overall."
Why GM is Betting on Sodium-Ion Batteries for BESS
Mukesh Chatter, co-founder and CEO at Alsym Energy. Credit: Alsym Energy
Na-Series BESS
, aptly named after the symbol for sodium on the periodic table of elements, features a non-flammable, sodium iron pyrophosphate (NFPP+) chemistry combined with an in-house proprietary technology that eliminates the risk of thermal runaway at the chemical level while still providing "best-in-class energy density." With a goal of building a lower-cost, safer BESS option that can be deployed around the world, Chatter and his organization are advancing the commercialization roadmap, and through a flurry of initiatives and partnerships that emphasize safety, domestic manufacturing & production, and operational efficiencies he expects to ship cells and modules to strategic partners starting in Q3 2026.
Driven to undertake a widescale mission to help others in part to honor the legacy of his late mother, who died due to complications of late-stage ovarian cancer nearly 10 years ago, Chatter turned to his background in electrical engineering to launch the company alongside former colleague and MIT professor Kripa Varanasi to advance his initiative rooted in what he has found to be a social responsibility.
Tempo's Thermochemical Energy Storage Aims to Make Industrial Electrification Economically Viable
"I wanted to take the passion that has made me successful and deploy that same passion into making a larger difference to the lives of many people," said Chatter. "It was one of those times when you ask yourself – what is my purpose? I don't want to be too philosophical, but that's exactly what this means to me. I think we can make a big difference for this unmet need today."
Alsym Energy BESS container. Credit: Alsym Energy
Through a newly formed collaboration with advanced manufacturing, engineering, and industrial development company
Re:Build Manufacturing
, Framingham, MA, Alsym has begun development of commercial-scale battery cells in the United States. The two companies intend to establish a competitive battery cell manufacturing capacity to support national energy security needs by focusing on commercial-scale sodium-ion battery cell manufacturing capacity in Re:Build's existing facility in New Kensington, PA, an area that reportedly possesses a deep, historical manufacturing expertise.
The domestic-first approach is expected to ensure that BESS original equipment manufacturers and developers can maximize tax benefits under the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) of 2022, legislation that is considered to be landmark federal law that is projected to cut greenhouse gas emissions by approximately 40 percent by 2030 and represents the largest climate and energy investment made in American history. "Partnering with Re:Build allows us to accelerate our roadmap toward domestic commercial production," said Chatter. "Their expertise in precision manufacturing and battery components is the perfect match for us. Together, we are providing a path for BESS integrators and developers to access high-quality cells that are not only non-flammable and high performance but are backed by a reliable, non-Foreign Entity of Concern (FEOC) supply chain—meaning a supply chain free from entities that may pose national security risks—that is fully compliant with tax credit and defense procurement rules."
IDTechEx Analyst Discusses BESS Safety Innovations and Trends
The organization has also recently announced a partnership with renewable energy developer
Juniper Energy
in San Mateo, CA, to deploy 500 megawatt hours (MWh) of the Na-Series BESS across the state of California as more organizations consider shifting away from lithium-ion in some of the most demanding climates in the United States. By integrating the Na-Series, Juniper Energy will begin to deploy storage that is expected to eliminate any current fire risks associated with deployments involving traditional chemistries while reducing levelized cost of storage.
Plans for the program's initial phase will focus on multi-megawatt deployments with a long-term vision to scale across Juniper's entire development pipeline. With a fast-charging capability of 30 minutes, the BESS is expected to enable Juniper to capitalize on a range of revenue-generating use cases from daily solar shifting to frequency regulation with the potential for multiple daily cycles. Among the other significant aspects of this arrangement will be the presence of the BESS units in the Mojave Desert and other high-temperature regions while helping the state to hedge against environmental concerns related to the concentration of rare-metal mining in the region. "Juniper Energy is a forward-thinking developer that recognizes the inherent limitations of lithium in warmer environments," said Chatter. "Our Na-Series technology was built for exactly this: providing high-performance, fast-charging storage that doesn't require complex cooling or risks community safety."
This past April, Alsym also signed a letter of intent with leading sustainable long duration energy storage system (LDES) manufacturer
, Wilsonville, OR, to assist the organization in its plans to add 8.5 gigawatt hours (GWh) of sodium ion cells and modules to its portfolio. This pairing will mark ESS Tech's entry into the short and medium duration BESS segment and is expected to expand the company's addressable market beyond its established position in LDES. "We are very pleased to be partnering with ESS," said Chatter. "As demand grows, it is increasingly clear that the industry needs solutions beyond lithium-ion to meet the speed and scale projections. By combining high performance, inherent safety, and supply chain resilience, Alsym's Na-Series delivers that capability, and ESS brings deep experience delivering grid-scale systems that maximize the value of renewable energy. Together, we are enabling a better path forward for energy storage."
Designed to address use cases traditionally served by lithium ion and those where lithium cannot, without the inherent thermal runaway risks, the Na-Series is not strictly a standard sodium ion. It is a proprietary combination of earth-abundant materials that are free of lithium, cobalt, nickel, and manganese; hard carbon for structural stability needed during charge and discharge phases; a proprietary electrolyte for both safety and performance. Additionally, the NFPP-based cathode combined with a unique package of dopants allow the system to operate with best-in-class energy density. The batteries also use aluminum current collectors that aren't subject to the same dissolution issues as copper that's utilized in lithium-ion. Unlike lithium, the Na-Series can charge and discharge up to 2C (twice their capacity per hour) without impacting service life. The batteries can maintain operation from –40°C to 60°C using only passive cooling despite the climate conditions. The robust hard carbon and stable electrodes reduce the range of mechanisms that cause degradation in lithium-ion batteries. "We have sodium with dopants, other materials that integrated into the electrode material," Chatter explained. "Sodium ion is a broad-based word, but once you look into the specifics, that's what separates us from the rest of the crowd. I genuinely believe we are farthest along by a wide margin compared to any other sodium ion company in the United States. And we're gaining good traction. I'm excited about it."
Chatter also says that Alsym's efforts have been accelerated by the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) through a physics-informed AI platform that is fundamentally improving how the company is discovering, developing, and scaling new chemistries. The platform
utilizes physics-guided AI
to narrow an otherwise endless range of battery chemistries — and rapidly converges on deployable options that are non-flammable and high-performance as opposed to exploring candidates in isolation. Machine learning is integrated with automated, closed-loop experimentation to extract maximum actionable learning from each test to facilitate progress across materials, cell design, and operating conditions beyond traditional trial-and-error approaches. Continuous electrochemical materials, molecular diagnostics, and feedback are applied to understand how and why batteries perform as they do to predict scaling from lab to prototype to pilot and commercial production. The AI also drives optimized system-level end-to-end co-design of materials, cell architecture, and manufacturing processes for what is expected to be better performance, safety, cost and manufacturability at scale.
In accelerated rate calorimetry testing, Na-Series BESS cells were heated from room temperature to 400°C without experiencing thermal runaway. In nail penetration tests conducted on fully charged cells, no rupture, fire, or flame was observed at any point.
"The safety of Na-Series enables deployments everywhere lithium-ion batteries can, and all the places lithium can't," said Chatter. "Social responsibility is a good thing—it's a civic duty. I think most people want to do the right thing for the larger cause. But the means have to exist to be able to help. And what we are doing is producing those means."

entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/锂电池
entries.as: 吉利发布Aegis金砖电池，充电峰值功率突破1,093 kW，创下电动汽车充电功率新纪录。该电池在1,000 kW以上车辆快充领域实现里程碑式突破，显著缩短充电时间，有望推动超快充技术在乘用车领域的规模化应用。

entries.b:
Geely has reached a new milestone in electric vehicle charging. Its Aegis Gold Brick Battery surpassed the 1,000 kW vehicle-side charging mark during recent state-certified tests in China. The China Automotive Technology and Research Center confirmed that Geely’s new short-blade lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery achieved a peak charging input of 1,093 kW, according to
This achievement comes as automakers are now competing to reduce charging times, not just to extend driving range.
Handling more than 1 MW of charging power brings significant heat management challenges. In China, regulations require battery temperatures to stay below 149°F (65°C) during charging. According to the certified evaluation, Geely’s battery reached a peak temperature of 147.2°F (64°C) even while drawing maximum power.
The battery uses a 900-volt system that helps it release heat more effectively during ultra-fast charging. Controlling the temperature protects the battery’s internal chemistry from acid buildup and long-term damage.
Geely’s battery uses a dual-sided 3D liquid cooling system that surrounds the cell groups with coolant. According to the company, this
doubles the heat-exchange surface and halves the distance heat must travel. The battery management software checks temperature data several times per second and adjusts the coolant flow to prevent hot spots from forming.

This battery technology is made for the Lynk and Co 10 electric sedan, which was recently launched in China. The base model starts at 169,900 yuan (about $23,700).
Certified tests showed the battery can charge from 10 percent to 70 percent in just 4 minutes and 22 seconds. This is much faster than the earlier 9-minute target for the Lynk & Co 10 EV.
During testing, the battery
These fast charging speeds help reduce downtime without needing battery-swapping systems or large external charging networks.
joins a fast-moving charging race among Chinese automakers. BYD, for example, has launched flash charging stations capable of delivering up to 1,500 kW and has set a 5-minute charging benchmark.
Geely’s approach is different because it focuses on how much power the vehicle can safely handle, rather than just boosting charger output. Making vehicle-side charging more efficient shortens charging times and reduces thermal stress on the battery cells.
Geely says the battery is built to last for 4,500 full charge cycles, which means it could last for over 621,000 miles (1 million km). To help more companies use this technology, Geely has open-sourced 12 structural patents for lower chassis battery protection. This lets other manufacturers adapt the designs for future electric vehicles and charging networks.

entries.t: 2608.360km：吉利银河 A7 EM 获吉尼斯世界纪录，达成驾驶插混量产轿车零补能行驶最远距离
entries.c: 通用技术/通信和运输/陆路运输
entries.as: 吉利银河A7 EM插电混动轿车以2608.360公里的零补能行驶里程获得吉尼斯世界纪录，创下插混量产轿车续航最远距离。该成绩展示了吉利在混动系统效率和整车能耗管理方面的工程实力，2026款银河A7 EM于今年4月发布，对插混市场竞争格局具有标志意义。
kp: 续航[插混量产轿车零补能]: 2608.360km
entries.b:
7 月 8 日消息，吉利汽车官方今日宣布，吉利银河 A7 EM 车型斩获吉尼斯续航新纪录，达成驾驶插混量产轿车零补能行驶最远距离，
共行驶 2608.360km
据IT之家此前报道，今年 4 月，
吉利汽车旗下 2026 款银河 A7 EM/ A7 EV 双车正式上市
。其中银河 A7 EM 上市限时先享指导价 8.98 万元起。
2026 款吉利银河 A7 EM 定位“电混家轿颠覆者”，拥有 2845mm 越级轴距，宣传可实现 2L 级超低馈电油耗，具备 235km 同级最长纯电续航、2150km 同级最长综合续航。
其他方面，该车将采用 10 层棉花糖 SPA 座椅，支持主副驾 14 点指压级座椅按摩，配备 16 扬 FlymeSound 无界之声音响系统、16.6 英寸大画幅 HUD。
它还搭载全新 Flyme Auto 2 智能座舱，配备了 14.6 英寸 2K 中控屏，手车互联还可支持 Carlink、HUAWEI HiCar、Flyme Link，交互体验简洁流畅；采用千里浩瀚辅助驾驶 H3 方案，支持高速领航驾驶辅助、多场景泊车等功能。
2026 款吉利银河 A7 EM / A7 EV 双车上市，限时先享指导价 8.98/10.28 万元起

entries.t: 大疆推出 DJI AP100 无人机降落伞：适配 Matrice 400，售价 7488 元
entries.c: 通用技术/通信和运输/航空
entries.as: 大疆发布行业应用首款无人机降落伞DJI AP100，专为Matrice 400设计，售价7488元。重约935克，IP55防护，-20°C至50°C工作。支持自动/手动双模式触发，600毫秒内完成旋翼停转与开伞，落地速度控制在5米/秒内。内置独立飞控和IMU形成双链路冗余架构，搭载智能检测算法降低误触发，双电容设计独立续航约1小时，断电情况下仍可自动开伞。
entries.b:
7 月 8 日消息，大疆今日发布了大疆行业应用首款无人机降落伞产品 ——DJI AP100 降落伞。该产品专为 Matrice 400 无人机设计，官方定价 7488 元，目前仅通过代理商渠道销售。
据官方介绍，AP100 降落伞重量约 935 克，具备 IP55 防护等级，可在-20°C 至 50°C 温度范围内工作。在触发机制方面，该降落伞支持自动与手动两种模式，官方标称可在 600 毫秒内完成旋翼停转与开伞动作，并将无人机落地速度控制在 5 米 / 秒以内。
IT之家注意到，安全冗余方面，AP100 内置独立飞行控制系统与 IMU 传感器，与无人机主控系统形成双链路冗余架构。即使飞行平台主控发生异常，降落伞仍可独立完成开伞操作。同时，系统搭载智能检测算法，可对双系统数据进行实时校验比对，以降低误触发风险。供电方面，AP100 采用内置双电容设计，独立续航时间约 1 小时，在飞行平台断电或 E-Port 连接中断的情况下仍能维持姿态检测与自动开伞功能。
在飞行全流程中，AP100 持续监测气体发生器状态与通信链路健康状况，异常情况可通过 DJI Pilot 2 的健康管理系统（HMS）界面实时告警。开伞指令下达后，独立的飞行终止系统（FTS）链路负责在 600 毫秒内切断电机动力，避免伞绳与旋翼发生缠绕。开伞后，设备将启动持续约 1 小时的声光报警，用于警示地面人员并辅助设备定位。
合规认证方面，AP100 与 Matrice 400 搭配使用可满足欧盟航空安全局（EASA）C5/C6 类及英国民用航空局（CAA）UK5/UK6 类安全运行要求，适用于城市人群上空（STS-01）及超视距飞行（STS-02）场景的适航申请。
实用性设计上，AP100 采用机身尾部固定安装方式，官方表示不影响电池更换与负载装配，且无需拆卸即可将无人机连同降落伞一并放入原装运输箱。重量方面，挂载该降落伞后，Matrice 400 仍保持 15.8 千克的满载起飞能力，续航时间缩短约 6 分钟。

entries.t: 单味金属中声子介导的延迟的超导性
entries.a: Recent Articles in Phys. Rev. Lett.
entries.c: 通用技术/材料工程/其它先进材料
entries.as: 该理论研究单味金属中由声子介导的配对现象。在可调贝里曲率的单味金属中，研究者发现一个意外结果：即使没有贝里曲率，纯粹的延迟效应也能产生p波超导性，而静态BCS近似无法预测这一现象。该发现拓展了对非常规超导机制的理解，表明声子延迟效应本身即可诱导非常规配对。发表于Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 026001。
